description: Kept the distance, and kept Nick's order about not being startled.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Moved the hook Sam could not reach, and said it was not Nick's fastening.
name: Edith Kettlewood

description: Asked to be left unpadded, and named twopence as the saving.
name: John Sincler

description: Called from Holywell, asked twice, and took the refusal.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Stood still for the hook, and kept his hands off the back of it.
name: Sam Latchet

description: Took the ground for Tybalt, and did not ask for a speech.
name: William Sly

description: Refused the extra lines, and did not print the five words.
name: William Shakespeare
